title: I edit my reels by texting my Hermes agent

body: Metricool: scheduled Thu 29 Oct 18:00 IG + TikTok
guide: Edit your videos by replying to a preview in Telegram, with an AI agent running a coding assistant on a computer at home to make the changes. You need a Telegram bot, an always-on computer with Claude Code and ffmpeg installed, an agent framework that can call Claude Code, and Google Drive.
1. Create a Telegram bot with BotFather and connect it to an open-source agent framework running on your home computer.
1. Install Claude Code and ffmpeg on that computer, and give the agent permission to start Claude Code in a folder that holds your video project.
1. Have the agent send each draft to you in Telegram as a numbered version, such as version 3.
1. Reply to that video in Telegram with what you want changed, for example "cut the pause after the hook".
1. Make the agent pass your reply and the current version to Claude Code, which edits the video with ffmpeg and saves it as the next version.
1. Have the agent send the new version back to you in Telegram and upload it to a Google Drive folder you have set aside for finishing in CapCut.
1. Open that file in CapCut, clean up or enhance the voice, and post.
Watch out: Only let the bot answer your own Telegram account, and keep Claude Code limited to the video project folder, so nobody else can send commands to your computer.
